info.title: BackupZit public API (Unirea fork)
info.description: One organization per console. Authenticate /api/v1 requests with Authorization: Bearer bzt_.... The token effective role is capped by its enabled owner current role. All errors use an English error string; mutating requests use application/json. API JSON responses use no-store. The separately scoped GET /agent/{file} installer download is public and cacheable. Enrollment agent protocol and browser-session routes are separate APIs.

license.name: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0

get.description: Get an active agent. name is the custom display label, falling back to the reported hostname. Removed agents return 404; their runs remain readable.

patch.description: Set name (trimmed, 1-255 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters). Does not change hostname reported by the machine, UUID, numeric ID, enrollment credentials or repo_dir. The name survives future agent polls. GET agents and GET agent return name, falling back to hostname for agents without a custom name. Uses the UI agent-management permission and records agent.rename audit. No four-eyes rule applies to naming. Removed agents return 404.

delete.summary: Remove an agent and keep its backups
delete.description: No request body. Equivalent to UI removal with backups=keep and uninstall=false. Uses the same agent-management permission, agent.delete audit and four-eyes approval. With approval enabled, returns 409 and creates a request for another user; the token owner cannot approve their own request. On completion the agent can no longer authenticate, its job configurations are deleted (not merely disabled), queued runs are dropped, and running/stopping runs are marked failed. All backup data on storage and completed run history are kept, also when no repository is registered. Retained runs keep their numeric run and agent IDs and have job_id:null; GET /runs/{id} remains readable. Software is still installed: uninstall locally if desired. Restore kept snapshots to another active agent via the existing restore API. This API never deletes backup data or schedules uninstallation. Repeating deletion returns 404.

post.summary: Ask an agent to send its log
post.description: Asynchronous; requires agent 0.38.0 or newer. Read GET /runs/{id}/log once delivered.

get.description: Includes expired, exhausted and revoked tokens, without secrets or BZ1 codes.

post.description: Use the BZ1 code with the existing agent installer/enrollment protocol. A valid pinned TLS certificate is required. Token use and the shared agent cap are checked atomically when an agent enrolls.

delete.description: Revocation blocks new enrollment and preserves metadata/agent provenance. Does not disconnect already enrolled agents; a second revocation returns 404.

post.summary: Create a file or Windows image job
post.description: Create a file or Windows image job

delete.description: Keeps existing backups. With four-eyes approval enabled, records a pending request and returns 409. A second user decides in the console. Group members cannot be changed individually. Completed runs keep their stable run/agent IDs and remain readable with GET /runs/{id}, with job_id:null.

post.description: Group members must be changed through the console group. Disabling with four-eyes approval enabled returns 409; request that change in the console, as before.
Group members must be changed through the console group. Disabling with four-eyes approval enabled returns 409; request that change in the console, as before.

get.description: Prometheus text exposition format 0.0.4. Uses the same Bearer token authentication as JSON routes.

get.summary: List runs with a stable cursor
get.description: Descending immutable run IDs. Retains the array response and all existing filters; concurrent insertions do not repeat or displace older pages. A missing cursor ID is also a valid exclusive numeric boundary.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter before applying the page limit.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Invalid, nonpositive or over-1000 values retain the existing fallback of 100.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Exclusive run ID cursor. Use the last id of the previous page.

get.description: Read a run by its stable BIGSERIAL ID, also after its job was deleted (job_id:null) or its agent was removed with backups kept. Agent IDs and run IDs use noncycling sequences and ordinary inserts do not reuse deleted IDs. IDs are scoped to a console database; store the console identity, agent ID and run ID for assisted recovery. Retained snapshot/repository fields are independent of the job configuration. Explicit destructive UI deletion or backup adoption can remove the old agent or change a run association; use the returned agent_id when resolving a request.

post.summary: Cancel or request stopping a run
post.description: Cancel or request stopping a run

get.summary: Stream a file or ZIP archive
get.description: A single file is streamed unchanged; a folder is streamed as ZIP. Same storage/backup limitations as /files. A storage/read failure after response headers aborts the connection, without appending JSON. Download is audited.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: File or folder snapshot path. / downloads the whole backup.

get.summary: List files in a backup folder
get.description: Same file-snapshot browser as the console. File and Linux system backups on console-accessible network storage. Local/USB storage, expired runs, images and SSH-key-only storage return 409, matching UI limitations.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Snapshot path with forward slashes; / is the root. No parent traversal or NUL.

get.description: Only agent-log runs. Returns 404 before the agent delivers the log.

post.summary: Queue file restoration on an agent
post.description: Returns the created run in the GET /runs/{id} shape. Supports file/system backups and file copies through the existing UI restore operation. Expired snapshots are rejected. A queued restore is asynchronous; monitor its run. The target agent needs access to the original repository.

delete.description: Rejects targets used by jobs. Keeps stored backups. With four-eyes approval enabled, records a pending request and returns 409 for a second user to decide in the console.

get.description: All available regular agent installer files, sorted by filename; [] if none are installed. Includes older versions and the legacy Windows installer (version ends in -legacy). OS uses windows/linux and arch uses Go names amd64/arm64/386/arm. Only strictly recognized versioned MSI, DEB and RPM filenames are included; server/repository packages, executables, recovery media, links and directories are excluded. size is in bytes. sha256 is lowercase hexadecimal, computed from the actual file and cached by identity, size and mtime. The portal selects a file for the OS/architecture and injects its file and sha256, the console public_url and a one-use BZ1 enrollment code into the examples. Do not send the portal API token to a new computer. Use a trusted HTTPS certificate for the public download. The MSI property is ENROLLCODE (packaging/windows/agent.wxs); the agent CLI is backupzit-agent enroll --code (cmd/backupzit-agent/service.go). Run PowerShell elevated. MSI exit 3010 means success with reboot required. Examples contain placeholders; SHA256_FROM_AGENT_PACKAGES must be replaced with the catalog SHA-256, and filenames with an actual catalog entry. No packages are fetched from upstream by this endpoint.

x-codeSamples.label: Windows MSI (elevated PowerShell)
Debian / Ubuntu
x-codeSamples.source:
set -eu
console='https://backup.example.com:8443'
file='backupzit-agent_0.47.3_amd64.deb'
sha256='SHA256_FROM_AGENT_PACKAGES'
code='BZ1-...'
package_dir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$package_dir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
curl --fail --silent --show-error "$console/agent/$file" --output "$package_dir/$file"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha256" "$package_dir/$file" | sha256sum --check --status
sudo apt-get install -y "$package_dir/$file"
sudo backupzit-agent enroll --code "$code"

get.summary: Download an agent installer without a session
get.description: Use this route at the root of the console public_url, outside /api/v1. It is public, including on the agent port when console UI network access is restricted. The filename must be a regular installer file accepted by GET /api/v1/agent-packages; no traversal, symbolic links or arbitrary files. MSI/DEB/RPM installers contain no enrollment secrets. Enrollment still requires a valid BZ1 code. The existing session-authenticated /downloads/{file} route is unchanged. GET also supports HEAD, byte ranges and conditional requests.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Exact file value from the authenticated agent package catalog.

Content-Length.description: Full file size for GET/HEAD; the selected range size for 206.

X-Content-SHA256.description: SHA-256 of the complete file. Verify against the digest supplied by the authenticated catalog.

206.description: Requested byte range; X-Content-SHA256 still describes the complete file.

Content-Length.description: Full file size for GET/HEAD; the selected range size for 206.

X-Content-SHA256.description: SHA-256 of the complete file. Verify against the digest supplied by the authenticated catalog.

500.description: Unable to calculate a consistent installer checksum.

id.description: Console-scoped BIGSERIAL identity, independent of the display name; ordinary inserts do not reuse deleted IDs.

os.description: Operating system and architecture joined with /.

name.description: Custom display name, or reported hostname when no custom name has been set.

Retention.description: Union of retention rules; all zero keeps everything. Yearly retention requires the fork agent advertising job-options-v1.

vss.description: Windows only. Omit/null uses the agent default; true/false overrides it. Requires an agent advertising job-options-v1.

image_disks.description: Image jobs: explicit whole-disk selection; omit/null uses image_disk. Requires an agent advertising job-options-v1.

pre_command.description: Only admin may change agent commands.

post_command.description: Only admin may change agent commands.

kind.description: Existing jobs of all kinds are returned; mutations support files and image.

schedule.description: Human-readable schedule. Use raw_schedule to read the stored value.

raw_schedule.description: Stored schedule: empty, cron expression, or an encoded Schedule JSON string.

schedule.description: Five-field cron expression, empty for manual, or a stored Schedule JSON string.

image_disk.description: -1 means all internal disks; non-negative is one disk. Alternatively set options.image_disks.

JobCreate.description: Files jobs require paths. Image jobs require a Windows agent and image_disk or options.image_disks. Without retention, defaults are keep_last=3, keep_daily=7, keep_weekly=4, keep_monthly=6. An explicit retention object starts from zero.

schedule.description: Five-field cron expression, empty for manual, or a stored Schedule JSON string.

image_disk.description: -1 means all internal disks; non-negative is one disk. Alternatively set options.image_disks.

JobPatch.description: Merge only the supplied fields, including nested options/retention. Kind, agent_id, target_id, image_disk and image_partitions are immutable, as in the UI. Use enable/disable to change enabled. Group members must be changed through the console group. Shorter retention returns 409 and creates an approval; other safe changes are saved immediately.

id.description: Console-scoped BIGSERIAL identity; ordinary inserts do not reuse deleted IDs.

recoveryKey.description: Shown once in this creation response. Store it safely; never returned by GET /targets.

S3TargetCreate.description: Creates encrypted storage and generates a recovery key, using the UI mutation. Creation does not test connectivity or create the S3 bucket. Configure Object Lock on the bucket beforehand when lockDays>0.

code.description: Shown once; includes server URL, secret enrollment token and the pinned certificate fingerprint.

EnrollmentCreate.description: Omitted maxUses defaults to 1; explicit null is unlimited. The legacy UI still issues unlimited tokens.

maxAgents.description: null is unlimited; zero prevents new enrollment. Counts all non-removed agents, including recovery media. Reducing the limit does not remove existing agents.

path.description: Snapshot path for subsequent browse/download/restore requests, e.g. /C/Users or /srv/data.

paths.description: Snapshot paths returned by /files. Use / to restore the whole backup. Converted to the source agent path syntax; local-storage restores need no console storage access.

agent_id.description: Defaults to the source run agent. May select another existing agent, as in the UI.

name.description: Trimmed name, 1-255 UTF-8 bytes and no control characters.

version.description: Package version, including package revision or -legacy where applicable.

history.description: Completed run history. Queued runs are dropped; running/stopping runs are failed.

Error401.description: Missing, invalid or expired API token.

Error403.description: The effective role does not permit this action.

Error409.description: Conflict, unsupported backup or approval required. Read error for details.

Error429.description: Too many failed sign-ins. Retry-After indicates seconds to wait.
